description: Explicit allowlist for backend routes that can return files, download links, exports, or printable data packages.

routes.isolation: OSS key is built with tenants/{tenantId}/areas/{areaId}/netdisk scoped prefix from the authenticated user.
routes.audit: Recorded in the data-egress allowlist as a reviewed audit exemption; downstream object access is tenant-area scoped and private download links expire within 10 minutes.
routes.watermark: Not applicable for raw binary netdisk downloads; file content is not transformed by the backend.
routes.reason: Returns an OSS download link and requires the dedicated netdisk:manage:download permission.

routes.permission: Uses an opaque token preview model with @AllowAnon; token must already be issued by an authenticated and authorized flow.
routes.isolation: Opaque token resolves to one protected-upload record only, requires scanStatus=2, and does not accept caller supplied tenant or area IDs.
routes.audit: Preview-token access is governed through this allowlist and served with no-store headers; authorized id-based access remains available for audited user-context reads.
routes.watermark: Inline preview only; watermark is not applied to binary file streams because original medical files must remain byte-faithful.
routes.reason: Returns a protected upload preview by opaque token only after scanStatus=2; token URLs are unguessable, expiring, and served with no-store headers.

routes.isolation: StorageService reads by id with the current authenticated tenantId and areaId.
routes.audit: Listed as a governed data-egress route and protected by tenant-area authorization; responses use no-store headers for traceable controlled reads.
routes.watermark: Inline preview only; watermark is not applied to binary file streams because original medical files must remain byte-faithful.
routes.reason: Returns a protected uploaded file by id and requires tool:storage:read plus tenantId and areaId authorization; responses use no-store headers.

routes.isolation: StorageService refreshes a preview token only after resolving the existing token against the current tenantId and areaId.
routes.audit: Token refresh is recorded in the data-egress allowlist as a reviewed audit exemption; the refreshed preview token remains short-lived and scoped to the same protected file.
routes.watermark: Not applicable because this route returns a scoped preview token, not rendered document content.
routes.reason: Refreshes a short-lived protected upload preview link and requires tool:storage:sign plus tenantId and areaId authorization.

routes.isolation: VisitService validates the visit against current tenantId, areaId, and current-staff scope before recording the print event.
routes.audit: Writes an EMR audit record with action=print before browser printing is allowed.
routes.watermark: Audit-only print flow; the frontend print layout carries patient and visit context while this endpoint records the mandatory print audit.
routes.reason: Records an audited medical-record print event before browser printing; returns no medical payload and validates tenantId, areaId, and current-staff scope through VisitService.
